text: {"name":"rf_tx_queue_process","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Processes queued transmit buffers and descriptor state, releases buffers with no outstanding references, and invokes transmit-pool initialization when the queue is empty.","subsystem":"rf","var_renames":{"v7":"descriptor_control_value","v8":"tx_buffer","v9":"tx_descriptor"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":4,"meaning":"Buffer-side 16-bit reference or use count; zero permits buffer release."},{"offset":68,"meaning":"Buffer-side flag that selects a descriptor control value."},{"offset":76,"meaning":"Pointer to the transmit descriptor."},{"offset":4,"meaning":"Descriptor control/status word; a negative value indicates hardware ownership or a pending state."}]}
